What is python-sounddevice?

python-sounddevice is a small Python library wrapping PortAudio, letting you play and record audio using NumPy arrays. It's aimed at developers, researchers and musicians who want simple, cross-platform programmatic control over audio input and output from Python, fitting naturally into existing NumPy-based signal-processing code.

Install python-sounddevice on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add python-sounddevice

Good to know

  • The PortAudio library installed on the system
  • A working audio input/output device to actually record or play sound
